CardDescription.DefaultText: Warm water surging in and out between the boulders. You can wash in a sheltered gap between the rocks, or hold your breath and dive along them for what clings there.

ActionDescription.DefaultText: Wade in and scrub off the road, the sweat and the sand.

CollectionMessages.DefaultText: A shark came out of the blue and bit you before you could reach the shallows.
You trod on an urchin and its spines broke off in your foot.
You trod on an urchin, but your footwear took the spines.

ActionDescription.DefaultText: Hold your breath and feel along the rocks for shells, weed and loose stones.

CollectionMessages.DefaultText: A shark came out of the blue and bit you before you could reach the shallows.
You trod on an urchin and its spines broke off in your foot.
You trod on an urchin, but your footwear took the spines.

ActionDescription.DefaultText: Cast a line from the shore and wait. What you land depends on this water and on how much of each fish is left in the sea.
Heave a net out from the shore and haul it back in. A net that comes up full holds two of a fish rather than one; what it holds depends on this water and on how much of each fish is left in the sea.
